title: Problem 360
subtitle: EDIT ME: one line on who it helps (Madurai residents reporting civic hazards in Tamil or English)
closing: EDIT ME: what you learned, in one line

scenes.title: An ordinary report
scenes.caption: Strands Decider + code decide the facts; the planner writes the reply; the critic checks it.
scenes.input: The street lights in our lane have not worked for a week and it is very dark at night.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "The street lights in our lane have not worked for a week and it is very dark at night." --category "Street lighting" --locality "KK Nagar"

scenes.title: A report in Tamil
scenes.caption: Same pipeline, reply in Tamil (Amazon Translate only if the model slips into English).
scenes.input: சிக்னல் அருகே சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது, வாகனங்கள் சிரமப்படுகின்றன
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "சிக்னல் அருகே சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது, வாகனங்கள் சிரமப்படுகின்றன" --category "Roads & potholes"

scenes.title: Danger: the hook stops the agents
scenes.caption: A Strands hook cancels every agent. Fixed text tells them to call 112. No model wrote it.
scenes.input: Live wire hanging from the electric pole near the bus stop, sparking when it rains.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "Live wire hanging from the electric pole near the bus stop, sparking when it rains." --category Electricity

scenes.title: Too vague to act on
scenes.caption: Code forces a request for details instead of a guess.
scenes.input: There is a problem here, please fix it soon
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "There is a problem here, please fix it soon"
